visualCharacteristics.purpose: Slim full-width linked announcement bar: small logo graphic beside one line of text
observed: Linked banner: Longhorn Lights logo image beside the text "Celebrate the season at Longhorn Lights | November 17 - January 1"

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: logo image | one line of text containing a link (a single link makes the whole bar clickable)
notes: Fixed pair of different content (logo graphic | text link) laid out side by side that never wraps; the section hint is block.

usage: Site-wide or seasonal announcement bars that link to one destination.
reuseGuidance: Use for a one-line linked notice with a logo; for image-and-text content panels use columns-promo.
